what: Section’s top edge as a curve sagging in the middle (quadratic curve control point = 3% of section height, 1% at 400px or less). It stays clipped, then is tied to scroll (scrub true, straight curve) from when the section head touches the bottom of the screen until it touches the top, and flattens out. This is the edge where the next section covers the pinned hero photo in an arch shape

options.narrow: Window width (px) or below treated as a narrow screen, default 400
options.scrub: Follow delay (seconds) — if empty, true (follows immediately)

use:
…Next section content…
(The covering panel itself gets clipped, so paint a background color. The previous section’s photo is pinned with sticky·pin)
